dl029_postmortem.discovery: S368 found the S821 DL-026 queue of 37 items/56 slots was overwhelmingly DL-029 false positives
dl029_postmortem.s369_ground_truth: Direct line-level inspection of all 37 S821-claimed items proved 92% (34/37) were clean. Only 3 Certified items carried genuine DL-026, with 1 empty non-CC field each.
dl029_postmortem.s821_comparison: 37 claimed → 3 genuine (8%). 34 items (92%) were DL-029 artifacts from the CC-before-QID window-scan bug.
dl029_postmortem.impact: DL-029 inflated the DL-026 inventory by more than 12×. The S821 'remediation queue' contained 34 authoring operations that would have targeted already-filled slots.
dl029_postmortem.resolution: 3 genuine items remediated S371. 0 Certified DL-026 remaining. DL-029 documented as confirmed methodology defect.
